title: The crossroad Part 3
author: Asjad Ullah
description: Mia wants to exploit a pre-marriage contract with her millionaire husband, Jones. She sets him up, so she could grab all his wealth, and enjoy life with her boyfriend Dan. But things go out of control, leaving everyone flabbergasted!

messages.text: Hey, baby, how’s the act going?
Great! Both of them are fools.
I have 200 grand in my account.
Perfect.
I’ve been missing you so badly.
Why?
So I see Mia is failing to satisfy you ;P.
Yeah, you’re wonderful.
So when should we meet?
Now, this world is cruel Dan.
Yeah, I know.
They’re husband and wife, and all they care about is money.
No, you don’t get it.
I was just thinking how bad it would be for you.
What hon?
That you’ll have to live with that boring Mia.
But that’s temporary, and then I’ll be with you.
The world is so cruel Dan.
You’ll never see me again darling.
I’m at the airport.
You’re such a whore.
Lol…a proud and successful one.
You were right Sandy.
This world is a cruel place.
A whore will always be a whore.
So I had done my homework.
What do you mean?
Look around you, sweetie.
You’re surrounded by security personnel.
Jones planned it all wonderfully.
Got rid of his unfaithful wife, saved his empire and cleared all the dirt on him.
And all of this was free of cost.
Have a nice time in jail sweetheart.
Truly the world is a cruel place.
